Phuket Island Rehab truly changed my life. From the moment I arrived, I felt safe, supported, and genuinely cared for. The staff are incredibly compassionate, professional, and deeply committed to each client’s healing journey. It never felt like “just a rehab” — it felt like a community that wanted me to succeed.

The program is well-structured while still being flexible and personalized. The therapists and counselors are highly skilled and approachable, and the holistic approach (mental, emotional, and physical healing) made a huge difference in my recovery. I learned tools here that I will carry with me for the rest of my life.
The location itself is peaceful and beautiful, which creates the perfect environment for reflection and growth. Being surrounded by nature while doing such deep inner work was incredibly grounding.

If you’re truly ready to change your life and are looking for a place that treats you with dignity, respect, and genuine care, I can’t recommend Phuket Island Rehab enough. I’m deeply grateful for this experience and for everyone who played a role in my recovery.

This place to me was much more than a rehab, it was a safe space to start to understand who i am and why i should be proud of that.
This for me was a life shifting experience. The clinical staff at PIR is world class. Their life experience, compassion, and genuine care for their clients is apparent in every interaction.
Through the amazing work done here, not only did I gain a solid root hold in my recovery journey, it was also a removal of a life long cage that held back the love and compassion I now have for myself in all my versions.
Combining the amazing clinical staff with their completely devoted support team and kitchen staff as well as their medical department, makes this place feel like home for a soul in transition. I would recommend to anyone that they give this beautiful place a chance to help them discover self, and through that they might just find that recovery is a far more fulfilling journey than they may have imagined.
I am Niko and I am proud to be me.
Lead with Love
-Niko Sikelianos

I cannot express enough gratitude for the life-changing experience I had at Phuket Island Rehab. This journey has not only given me a new lease on life but has also transformed my entire outlook on healing and personal growth. The expertise, dedication, and genuine care from the entire team made all the difference in my recovery.

A special thank you to John and Gift for their incredible depth of knowledge and unwavering support. Their guidance helped me realize that the power to enact change was within me all along. To the support staff, Win, Nati, Alex, William, Kevin, thank you for always prioritizing our well-being, keeping up with our endless needs, and making us feel cared for every step of the way.

To Lek, our amazing yoga instructor—your kindness, encouragement, and the mindfulness you taught me through meditation were truly invaluable. You showed me a level of peace I never thought possible. And to the kitchen staff, thank you for nourishing us with the most delicious and nutritious meals. Your food was more than just sustenance; it was a source of comfort and joy during this journey.

This experience has fed my soul in ways I never expected. It has given me back my confidence, my sense of self, and a renewed belief in my ability to heal and grow. Phuket Island Rehab is truly a place of transformation, and I will forever be grateful for the care and support I received here.

This place is truly amazing and for anyone in need of rehabilitation please come here. I am an alcoholic and have been to many rehab centres in the UK and Turkey without any success but truly for the first time I have hope of a new life without alcohol which I never had previously. They collect you from the airport and you are looked after the moment you enter the rehab. There are many more rehabs out there which are more expensive but in this case more expensive does not mean better:)
The rooms are really nice and I stayed in an ocean view room with a relaxing terrace next door to have my morning coffee. The food is fantastic with a real variety in choice from authentic curries to fish and so much more made by chef Ramen.. Coffee machine is available with multiple choices . You get 3 meals a day so no need to worry about food . A special shout goes to John my therapist with whom I had three one to one sessions a week with. He really understands you and has a very calming persona which allows you to open up.

You have many group sessions with the lovely Toni & Gift (also John) which teach you new life skills and how to cope with triggers and craving and I have learnt things I never knew to help me in my recovery.

There is many activities you can participate in (It is your choice) such as Yoga, Singing bowl  Muay thai massages and art classes.

You also have weekend excursions to beaches ,night markets and temples (optional again) and many more.

It sometimes feels like you are on holiday :)

Another special mention to the lovely Dawie who takes the yoga classes(also she is a support worker)s she is a breath of fresh air and has such an infectious bubbly personality and is good to be around.

With regards to all other staff I cannot fault anyone as this truly is a great place which I would recommend to anyone in need of addiction treatment.

I honestly never write reviews but felt I had to this time as I reached rock bottom but this place has made me believe I can enjoy live away from alcohol and has given me many tools to put in place to deal with my issues.

I actually turned up really drunk(shock for an alcoholic ha) but was given a diazapem program and got through the withdrawal which as anyone with an addiction is aware withdrawal is the hardest part and makes you still use but I came through it . I will continue online therapy sessions with John online .

These people really care about you so do yourself a favour , If you have lost all hope get in touch with Kevin and get yourself booked in. Kevin is a great guy also and makes the process so easy with excellent communication . I called one day and was there 5 days later .

The support staff Ye ,,Khao Alex and Dawie who take you on excursions are all really nice people and always ready to help with anything you nee

Take what you want from this review but it is all true and I hope everyone who is active addiction  there is hope and this place can 100% get you felling so much better at a fraction of the costs of over rehabs.

So thank you to everyone at Phuket Island Rehab for giving me hope again.

I really want to thank Phuket Island Rehab for all they did for me.

At first I was a little worried because of the one negative review of the place but I’m so happy I trusted my gut as it was the BEST thing I could have done for myself. From the moment I arrived, I felt safe, supported, and genuinely cared for. The facilities are absolutely beautiful. The environment is peaceful and clean, and everything is designed to help you feel calm and grounded. The rooms were spacious and extremely comfortable. I never once felt like I was missing anything. Every level of care was provided without me even needing to ask.

The food was incredible. Every meal was fresh, healthy, and full of flavor. You could tell the staff put thought and effort into making sure we were nourished and well-fed. Eating well every day played a big part in helping me feel stronger, both physically and emotionally.

The therapy I received was on a completely different level. Toni and John have an incredible ability to truly understand addiction and the underlying pain that comes with it. They helped me dig deep and process things I had avoided for years. Their honesty, empathy, and insight made such a difference. I will never forget what they taught me.

The support workers were absolutely amazing. Daiwe, Gao, Ye, and Alex were always there when we needed something. Whether it was helping with day-to-day tasks, checking in with us, or just having a kind word ready when the days were tough, they always made us feel comfortable. Their presence created such a calm and safe atmosphere, and it meant a lot knowing they were always close by. The outings I had were also so beautiful and gave a sense of freedom.

Phuket Island Rehab gave me a second chance. I arrived unsure of myself and uncertain about my future. I left with clarity, strength, and a deep sense of gratitude. I will carry this experience with me for the rest of my life. If you are thinking about getting help, this is the place. They do not just help you get clean. They help you heal. All my love to the staff and other clients 💕

Life-Changing Experience at Phuket Island Rehab

Choosing Phuket Island Rehab was the best decision I’ve ever made. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with open arms by a team that genuinely cares about every person who walks through their doors. The setting is absolutely serene—tucked away in a peaceful corner of paradise, it’s the perfect place to heal and find yourself again.

What truly sets this rehab apart, though, are the people. Yong was an incredible support throughout my journey—compassionate, wise, and always present with encouragement exactly when I needed it most. Natti brought such warmth and positivity into every session; his ability to connect on a deep, human level made all the difference for me.

The therapy programs were personalized and comprehensive, combining evidence-based practices with holistic approaches that made me feel seen and understood. From group work and one-on-one sessions to mindfulness exercises and outdoor activities, everything was designed to help me heal not just physically, but mentally and spiritually.

I left Phuket Island Rehab not just sober, but transformed—with clarity, confidence, and a new lease on life. If you’re looking for a place that truly prioritizes your recovery in a safe, stunning, and supportive environment, this is it.

Forever grateful to the entire team, especially John, Natti & Yong —you helped me reclaim my life.

I cannot thank this rehab center enough for the role it has played in my recovery journey. What was initially supposed to be a short stay turned into a full 3-month program — and that decision truly changed my life.

I came in struggling with major depressive disorder which led to excessive alcohol use, feeling completely lost and hopeless. From day one, the environment here felt safe, welcoming, and judgment-free. The staff went above and beyond to make me feel comfortable and supported. Everyone — from the support staffs, cooks, nurses to the counselors — treated me with kindness, compassion, and patience.

One of the things I appreciated most was that the center doesn’t enforce recovery through pressure or control. Instead, they guide you with empathy and give you the space to heal at your own pace. They empower you to take accountability for your actions, which helped me feel more in control of my recovery rather than being forced through it. That sense of trust and personal responsibility made a huge difference in my growth.

A special thank you to my therapists, John and Gift. Their approach to therapy was not only professional but deeply human. I was able to open up about past traumas and finally begin to work through layers of pain I had buried for years. With their guidance, I learned practical coping skills, gained emotional insight, and started believing in recovery again.

This place became more than just a treatment center — it became a turning point in my life. I’m walking away stronger, clearer, and finally hopeful. If you or a loved one is struggling, I cannot recommend this place enough.

Dear Phuket Rehab team

I hope this message finds you well. I’m reaching out to share my thoughts about my brief stay at your facility. My intention is to provide insights for those considering treatment here.

Unfortunately, my experience was not what I had hoped for, and I feel compelled to explain why I’ve rated the facility low.

Upon my arrival, I was picked up from a local motel, and I was not in a great mental space. The initial process went smoothly, and I appreciated the IV treatment I received to help detoxify my body. Regarding the accommodations, they were acceptable for the price, but I was disappointed with the room I paid extra for, which was promised to have sea views. In reality, my view was limited to the pool area. A tip for future clients: consider opting for a standard room, as some actually have ocean views.

The most significant letdown for me was the food. Thailand is renowned for its incredible cuisine, yet the meals provided at the facility fell far short of what one could experience in Phuket. It would have been wonderful to see more local flavors incorporated into the menu.

My main reason for writing is to address my abrupt dismissal from the facility on day four due to breaking a rule against sharing substances. I acknowledge my part in this, but I also believe that a rehab facility has a responsibility to support its clients effectively.

Firstly, the search of my belongings was inadequate, allowing cannabis and pharmaceutical pills to remain in my bag. This not only compromised my wellbeing but also the safety of other clients.

Secondly, the medical care provided by a staff member lacking proper qualifications raised concerns. I was administered a substantial amount of medication, including multiple sleeping pills and diazepam, without adequate supervision or assessment of my needs. This practice seems risky, especially in a recovery environment. And the fact I was given these takeaway in a bag as opposed to them making you swallow what you feel you might need in front of them. A very standard practice in rehab I believe.

During a group outing to a nearby island, I encountered situations that made it easy to access substances, which was particularly challenging given my early recovery stage. Although I made mistakes in my choices, I felt that the lack of supervision and structure during these outings was inappropriate for individuals in early recovery.

Upon returning from the outing, I was informed that I was being dismissed based on actions captured on camera, without prior discussion or a chance to address the situation. I was returned to a budget hotel, leaving me feeling abandoned at a vulnerable time in my life.

Fortunately, I found the strength to pull through, largely thanks to the support of my daughter and a local community that embraced me. I’m now nearly two months clean and believe that my experiences, though painful, have contributed to my recovery journey.

I reached out to the owner regarding my concerns and requested acknowledgment of the issues I faced, including a refund for the nights I could not stay. Unfortunately, I received no response, which left me feeling disregarded.

While the onsite staff were friendly and supportive, particularly Kevin in administration, who genuinely cared about the clients, I believe there is a critical need for improved oversight and accountability within the organization. A focus on client welfare rather than financial gain would greatly enhance the experience for those seeking help.

Thank you for taking the time to read my feedback. I hope it can lead to positive changes for current and future clients.

Best regards,
Ashley
